posts.author: Prabhat_Mohanty
posts.text: I endorse views expressed by @Phreakv6 . I don’t want to analyse more . Suffice to say that you must be able to differentiate between management’s projection whether it is pragmatic or lofty. This is about management quality. So 12-15 % revenue growth which is sustainable is ok with me, coming from Venus management. I am sure we will see about 20% growth at the year end. And let us not forget that Pharma R&D is a long term game. There is a big feather in their cap that almost 70% is export. Is it not a certificate on their quality? May be recent drop in the share price is inducing these doubts…

posts.author: Vamesh_Chovatia
posts.text: Review their Capitalization policy, especially as it relates to R&D expenses, including how they are capitalized and written off, and over what period.
